description: Real-Time Predictive Traffic Signal Control Application for Prototyping is a model or code deposit deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Muriel Poelman. This prototyping environment is made available to evaluate predictive traffic signal control applications in a 'controlled' real-time simulation environment to gain insights for development and design of these predictive control systems in real-life. The prototyping environment is developed as part of a PhD project to study predictive traffic signal control systems under uncertainties. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is GPL-3.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
